summary.headline: Mundane Astrology and the Year
summary.text: Mundane astrological rules for pestilence, war, slaughter, and death from configurations of Saturn, Mars, malefics, angles, and signs; Chapter 23 then begins instructions for judging the year through Saturn’s conjunctions, the lord of the year, and the king’s significator.
